row.name: Ibotta Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)
checks.note: the session before the burst was up and not narrow

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=17 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.28 tightness=0.64 base_volume_vs_leg=0.76 base_volume_vs_avg=0.84
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 5.1% vs its 20-SMA, 7.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar itself is clean — closes at 0.95 of its range, above the open, with volume above the prior session — but two measured defects drag the setup below A quality: RE fails badly (burst bar is only 69% of the widest bar in the prior five sessions, 53% of the prior ten), and N fails because the day before was up 1.39% with a wide 4.7% range rather than a quiet narrow setup. The base shaded on the chart looks reasonably orderly over 17 sessions with one burst inside it, but the prior leg's R² of 0.36 is below the A+ threshold and the chart shows the move from late July to mid-September was partly gap-driven off a sharp low, not a clean stair-step.
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts worked only 1 of 4 times in the last 60 sessions, and the stock is already 80% off its move-start with the burst bar failing to expand range meaningfully, limiting follow-through potential.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the base high of 43.43 or if the first 30 minutes show price fading back below the prior close of 41.53.
